shortDescription: Italian engineering group Maire MIL:MAIRE said on Sunday its subsidiary Nextchem would acquire natural gas liquefaction process technologies from Chart Industries, a unit of US-based Baker Hughes NASDAQ:BKR for $220 million.Here are some details:($1 = 0.9074 euros)

children: said on Sunday its subsidiary Nextchem would acquire natural gas liquefaction process technologies from Chart Industries, a unit of US-based Baker Hughes
Nextchem will acquire Chart Industries' mid-scale integrated pre-cooled single mixed refrigerant, small-scale LNG process technologies, related intellectual property, and more than 90 patents
Maire expects the licensing business to generate EBITDA of at least $25 million in 2027, and said the acquisition would be accretive to its EBITDA margin

As part of the transaction, Nextchem will enter into a 10-year cold-box supply agreement with Chart Industries and offer customers an integrated LNG platform covering process licensing, engineering services and key equipment supply
The deal with Chart Industries is expected to close by year end or early January 2027

The acquisition follows a memorandum of understanding signed in February between Maire's Tecnimont unit and Baker Hughes on LNG initiatives. Tecnimont subsequently won 110 million euros ($121.23 million) of contracts for gas and LNG projects in South America and Asia in August
